subject: Novara Tech — onboarding: entity details & forms
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alan Price <alan.price@novara-tech.com>
Cc: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Novara Tech — onboarding: entity details & forms

Hi Alan —

Thanks for agreeing to get Novara set up in our vendor system. To keep the onboarding moving, can you please provide the following so Finance can create the vendor record and approve POs: 

- Legal entity name (exact as on tax documents)
- Entity type (C-Corp, LLC, Partnership, etc.)
- Tax ID / EIN (or VAT number if non-US)
- Legal address (street, city, state, ZIP, country)
- Remittance address (if different)
- Primary billing contact (name, title, email, phone)
- Bank details for ACH (bank name, account last 4, ACH routing) or a W-9 for US vendors
- Any required certificates (insurance, COI)

I attached our one-page Vendor Onboarding form to make this easier — feel free to fill it and return, or upload via the DocuSign link below. If you can get this back by end of day Tuesday (6/22), we should be able to create the vendor record and issue an initial PO the following week.

Attachments: Redwood_Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf (please return filled), Vendor_Onboarding_Instructions.pdf
DocuSign link: https://app.docusign.com/some-doc-link/novara-onboard

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com

From: Alan Price <alan.price@novara-tech.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: vendor-ops@novara-tech.com
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Novara Tech — onboarding: entity details & forms

Hi Soojin —

Thanks — attaching the completed onboarding form and our W-9. See answers inline on the PDF. Quick notes: 

- Legal name: Novara Technologies, Inc.
- Entity type: C-Corporation (Delaware)
- EIN: 12-3456789
- Legal address: 100 Broad St, Suite 1200, San Francisco, CA 94105
- Remittance address: PO Box 4521, San Francisco, CA 94102 (different from legal)
- Billing contact: Emily Santos, Billing Manager — emily.santos@novara-tech.com / +1 (415) 555-2121
- Banking: We prefer wires for first payment; ACH details in the attached PDF (bank routing masked in shared copy)

Best,

Novara Technologies
alan.price@novara-tech.com

From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Novara Tech — onboarding: entity details & forms

Soojin / Marissa —

Thanks for the submission — I reviewed the attachments. A couple of operational notes before we create the vendor record in NetSuite: 

1) We need to confirm whether the remittance PO Box must be the remit address in NetSuite or whether Novara prefers invoices to the legal address and remittance handled separately. If Novara wants separate remit, set Remit-To in vendor profile to PO Box.

2) For the initial payment we can accept wire; Finance will record the bank account but we must not store full account numbers in the vendor profile for security. Please ask Alan if they will accept an ACH tokenized payment (preferred) or a one-time wire.

3) Please confirm if Novara qualifies for our standard 30/Net60 billing terms or requires a different SLA.

Once confirmed, I'll provision the vendor record (vendor id will be prefixed NVRA-) and route for AP approval.

-Michael
Senior Director, Finance Operations
michael.grant@redwoodinference.com

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alan Price <alan.price@novara-tech.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Novara Tech — onboarding: entity details & forms

Hi Alan —

Thanks for the fast response and the attachments. Per Michael's notes: 

- We will set the vendor legal name to "Novara Technologies, Inc." and Remit-To as the PO Box you listed. Please confirm if invoices should be addressed to the legal address or to the billing contact at the remit address.
- Finance prefers a tokenized ACH for ongoing payments; would you be able to accept a tokenized ACH? If not, we'll process a one-time wire for the first invoice.
- Standard terms are 30/Net60 unless you request otherwise.

Next steps: once you confirm the invoice remit preference and ACH/wire preference, Finance will create NVRA-#### in NetSuite and I will send our PO/contract reference and onboarding instructions. I've attached a short PO_Instructions.pdf to help Novara's AP team with invoice routing and required PO fields.

Attachments: PO_Instructions.pdf
Confluence onboarding: https://redwoodinference.atlassian.net/l/c/Onboarding-Forms-2026

Appreciate it — looking forward to closing this out early next week.

Best,
Soojin
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com
